item.title: ABB launches integrated carbon capture measurement solution
item.description: ABB has announced the launch of its first fully integrated gas analyser package for carbon capture, utilisation, and storage applications for the decarbonisation of hard-to-abate industries.

item.title: Babcock LGE receives 150th order for LNG reliquefaction system
item.description: Babcock’s LGE business has secured its 150th contract for its ecoSMRT® LNG reliquefaction system.

item.title: Worley tapped as technical advisor for New Zealand LNG import terminal
item.description: Worley will provide technical advisory and client engineering support for the development of New Zealand’s LNG import terminal.

item.title: CMA CGM concludes LNG-powered vessel order
item.description: CMA CGM has signed the final contract with Cochin Shipyard Ltd for six LNG-powered vessels, as well as the recruitment of up to 1500 Indian seafarers by the end of 2026.

item.title: BV grants AIP for five vessel projects by Hudong-Zhonghua
item.description: Bureau Veritas Marine & Offshore has awarded approval in principle certificates for five advanced gas carrier and FSRU projects developed by Hudong-Zhonghua Shipbuilding (Group) Co., Ltd.

item.title: Indonesia inaugurates first modular micro LNG plant
item.description: Indonesia has inaugurated its first modular micro LNG plant developed by PT Likuid Nusantara Gas utilising Galileo Technologies' Cryobox technology.

item.title: Wärtsilä Gas Solutions receives LNG cargo handling and fuel gas supply systems order
item.description: Wärtsilä Gas Solutions will supply its cargo handling and fuel gas supply systems for two new LNG bunkering vessels being built at the Zhejiang XinLe Shipbuilding yard in China.

item.title: SK Innovation to lead US$2.3 billion LNG mega project in Vietnam
item.description: SK Innovation has been selected to lead a landmark LNG power project in Nghe An Province, Vietnam.

item.title: INPEX granted environmental approval for Abadi LNG project
item.description: INPEX CORP. has received environmental approval for the Abadi LNG project from the government of Indonesia.

item.title: Uniper and GSPC sign long-term LNG supply agreement
item.description: Uniper and GSPC have finalised an up to 10-year LNG agreement for deliveries of up to 0.5 million tpy into India.
